第42章 各凭本事吃饭-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

“没事，”老周摇了摇头，“就是……唉，对面那个钱大勇，手艺是真不行。

烧饼夹肉里的肉柴得很，卤汤味道也不对，咸得要命。

面条更不用说了，碱放多了，吃起来发苦。

便宜是便宜，但便宜没好货啊。”

赵志军忍着笑，假装很严肃地点了点头：“那你这一周都吃的啥？”

“别提了，”老周摆了摆手，“我吃了三天就受不了了，又去旁边包子铺吃了两天，今天实在忍不住了，还是你家的好吃。”

赵志军终于没忍住，笑了出来。

老周吃完两个肉夹馍，把碗里的面汤也喝了个精光。

他抹了抹嘴，心满意足地叹了口气：“还是林师傅的手艺对胃口，以后不瞎跑了，就在你家吃。”

老周走后，又有几个老顾客陆续回来了。

理由都差不多。

对面的东西便宜是便宜，但味道不行，吃了几天就腻了。

“三姐夫，你说对了！”

赵志军兴奋得差点跳起来，“老周回来了，老李也回来了，还有农机厂那几个，都回来了！”

林国强笑了笑，没说什么，继续煮面。

优惠活动结束后，王家小吃的生意一落千丈。

钱大勇把价格调回了正常。

烧饼夹肉三毛，阳春面四毛，跟林国强的一样。

但客人不买账了。

同样的价格，味道差一大截，凭什么吃你家的？

原来每天排队的王家小吃，现在门口冷冷清清的，一天下来也卖不出多少。

钱大勇站在门口，看着对面国强小吃进进出出的客人，脸上的表情很复杂。

赵志军每次路过的时候都会偷偷看一眼，回来跟林国强报告：“三姐夫，对面今天又没啥人。”

“别管人家的事，把自己的活儿干好。”

“我知道，我就是……”赵志军嘿嘿笑了，“就是觉得解气。”

林国强瞪了他一眼：“解什么气？人家做生意也不容易。

各凭本事吃饭，别幸灾乐祸的。”

赵志军缩了缩脖子，不说话了，但嘴角还是翘着的。

又过了几天，王家小吃换了菜单。

门口的黑板擦掉了原来的字，换上了新的。

“炒饼、炒面、鸡蛋灌饼、韭菜盒子、小米粥。”

牛肉面和阳春面还在，但被挪到了最下面，字体也小了一号。

新添的几样东西，都是国强小吃没有的。

赵志军跑来看了一眼，回去跟林国强说：“三姐夫，对面换菜单了。

"It's okay," Lao Zhou shook his head, "It's just...well, that Qian Dayong opposite is really not good at his craftsmanship.

The meat in the sesame cakes was very hot, and the braised soup didn't taste right, it was terribly salty.

Not to mention noodles, if too much alkali is added, they will taste bitter.

Cheap is cheap, but cheap goods are not good."

Zhao Zhijun suppressed his laughter and nodded pretending to be serious: "Then what did you eat this week?"

"Forget it," Lao Zhou waved his hand, "I couldn't stand it after three days of eating it, and then I went to the bun shop next door to eat it for two days. I just couldn't bear it today. Yours is still delicious."

Zhao Zhijun finally couldn't hold it back and laughed.

After finishing two meat buns, Lao Zhou drank all the noodle soup in the bowl.

He wiped his mouth and sighed with contentment: "Master Lin's craftsmanship is still to my taste. From now on, if I don't run around blindly, I will eat at your house."

After Lao Zhou left, several old customers came back one after another.

The reasons are pretty much the same.

The food on the other side is cheap, but the taste is not good. I will get tired of it after eating it for a few days.

"Third brother-in-law, you are right!"

Zhao Zhijun almost jumped up with excitement, "Lao Zhou is back, Lao Li is back, and those from the agricultural machinery factory are all back!"

Lin Guoqiang smiled, said nothing, and continued cooking noodles.

After the promotion ended, Wang's snack business plummeted.

Qian Dayong adjusted the price back to normal.

The sesame seed cakes are stuffed with meat for three cents and the Yangchun noodles are four cents, just like Lin Guoqiang’s.

But the customers didn’t buy it.

The same price but a huge difference in taste, why should I eat yours?

The Wang's snacks that used to line up every day are now deserted at the door, and they don't sell much in a day.

Qian Dayong stood at the door, looking at the guests coming in and out of Guoqiang Snacks opposite, with a complicated expression on his face.

Zhao Zhijun would take a sneak peek every time he passed by and report to Lin Guoqiang when he came back: "Third brother-in-law, there are no people across the street today."

"Don't mind other people's business and do your job well."

"I know, I just..." Zhao Zhijun chuckled, "I just feel relieved."

Lin Guoqiang glared at him: "Why are you so angry? It's not easy for people to do business.

Everyone eats according to his ability, don't take pleasure in others' misfortune."

Zhao Zhijun shrank his neck and stopped talking, but the corners of his mouth were still raised.

A few days later, Wang's snacks changed their menu.

The original words on the blackboard at the door were erased and replaced with new ones.

"Fried pancakes, fried noodles, egg-filled pancakes, leek boxes, millet porridge."

The beef noodles and Yangchun noodles are still there, but they have been moved to the bottom, and the font size is also one size smaller.

Several newly added items are not available in Guoqiang Snacks.

Zhao Zhijun ran to take a look, then went back and said to Lin Guoqiang: "Third brother-in-law, the menu has changed across the street.
